description:
## 1.1.1 (2026-11-01)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Fixed the bundle missing `classes.dex`, which made Morphe Manager show version 1.1.0 with **0 patches**. The bundle is now built with `:patches:packageBundle`, which verifies the Android patch code is present

### ✨ New Features (1.1.0)

* My POIs: new main-menu entry under My Places with named folders of saved places, add-from-My-Places, add-by-coordinates and an "Add to My POIs" button on map popups

### Previous

* Unlock Premium Subscription: TomTom's subscription checks always report an active paid plan; trial timeline/paywall and free-trial card removed
* Unlock Truck Profile: full truck vehicle profile (dimensions, weight, ADR) is always enabled
